intro: The Hunter's Path is a rite of passage offered to novice dwarven hunters across Dun Morogh once they reach basic competence in tracking and marksmanship. Local trainers direct their apprentices to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos to begin learning the art of taming wild beasts as permanent companions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I do believe you are ready, as well....
